# codencode.my

> Affordable online coding academy based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Teaches Python, machine learning, AI and related tech skills 100% online via Zoom, in English, Mandarin (中文) and Bahasa Melayu.

codencode.my (legal entity: CODE N CODE SOLUTION, 202603072017 / AS0511861-M) runs live, instructor-led online courses for beginners through career changers. No prior experience required. Every session is recorded and uploaded within 24 hours. First class is free.

## Courses
- Python Fundamentals — 6 weeks, beginner, RM 1,500 (promo, normally RM 2,000)
- Machine Learning Fundamentals — 10 weeks, intermediate, RM 2,000 (promo, normally RM 2,500)
- Vibe Coding (building apps with AI tools: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude) — 4 weeks, beginner, RM 800
- Prompt Engineering (ChatGPT, Claude, LLM APIs) — 5 weeks, beginner–intermediate, RM 1,000
- Data Analytics (Python, Pandas, Power BI) — 6 weeks, beginner–intermediate, RM 1,200
- No-code AI & Automation (Make, n8n, Zapier + AI) — 4 weeks, beginner, RM 800
- Web Dev + Portfolio Builder (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) — 5 weeks, beginner, RM 1,200

All courses are taught in English, Mandarin and Bahasa Melayu, delivered online via Zoom.
